Vision & Mission

Our Vision

To be the leading professional society in advancing radiology, education, and scientific research in Sudan and the region.

Our Mission

To unite professionals working in radiology, promote the highest standards of professional practice and patient safety, support continuing education and scientific research, and represent the profession before national and international bodies.

Our Goals

In pursuit of our mission, the Society strives to:

01

Represent the interests of radiology professionals before government bodies, health authorities, and the community.

02

Establish and uphold professional and ethical standards of practice, with mechanisms to ensure compliance.

03

Encourage and facilitate scientific research and academic publication in the radiology sciences.

04

Organize and support continuing professional development, including conferences, workshops, training courses, and scientific meetings.

05

Promote excellence, safety, and quality assurance in diagnostic and interventional radiology practice.

06

Strengthen cooperation and partnerships with national, regional, and international professional bodies and institutions.

07

Contribute to developing policies, curricula, and regulatory standards related to radiology.

08

Raise public awareness of the safe and appropriate use of radiation services and technologies.

09

Support the welfare and professional development of members at every stage of their careers.

Pink October Campaign

This October we wanted breast cancer awareness to be more than a poster and a lecture. We want it present everywhere: in our hospitals, universities, colleges, and radiology departments across Sudan.

Join the campaign: Every Story Is Unique, Every Journey Matters

Participation is open to everyone. Wherever you are in Sudan, you can be part of the story:

  • Share a photo of yourself or your team with the campaign poster, taken at your workplace or place of study.
  • Or share a short video, up to 10 seconds, that carries the spirit of support and includes our campaign slogan.
  • Film it from a hospital or department, a university or college, or anywhere in Sudan.
  • Email your photos and videos to ssmi00249@gmail.com.

When you post, please use our hashtags: #SSMI#EveryStoryMatters
